summary: Narrow leafy residential street with houses 7-11 m from every stretch.
reasons: Quiet street, a van would stand out

best_section.where: Southern end of the west kerb, past the bend

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 9-11 m from the kerb on the same side, many more close behind.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with little verge; few cars parked, so room beside the lane is tight.
drivers.convention: No sign of parked cars or overnight stays; the van would be noticed.

flags: Steep in the middle: up to 23% max
Near Sandy Creek, low-lying at about 18 m
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy and house shade; patchy sun.
